data.title: The prompt hook misses rejected ideas phrased in everyday words
data.description: Two misses captured while building the site's hero (notes on KAD-73): 'Let's add embeddings to kadence search so it understands synonyms' does not bring DEC-26 into the top three although its Rejected line opens with 'Embeddings, in the core'; 'Can we switch the core to async file reads?' does not return DEC-39 at all. The hero now promises this behaviour, so the misses are the product's, not the measurement's.
